name: Taifoon — resell through n8n (quote a plan, mint a customer key, read the margin)

nodes.name: Start
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · you hold a Taifoon Relayer API credential (template 11 minted it); every tenant is a reseller by default

nodes.name: Get Access Quote
nodes.notes: in: — → out: https://www.taifoon.io/schemas/coordination/v1/ · Taifoon Account → Get Access Quote: GET /v1/access/quote?plan=builder-99&chainId=8453 with X-API-Key → pay { the exact transfer } + sign { the exact message naming YOUR key }; nothing is signed or sent

nodes.name: Mint Child Key
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · DISABLED until you enable it (a run mints a real customer tenant, 10 a day): Taifoon Account → Mint Child Key: POST /v1/tenant/keys { action: child, label, markup_bps } → the customer's keys, shown ONCE; its calls are debited from your balance at the list price and it owes you list + markup

nodes.name: Get Reseller View
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · Taifoon Account → Get Reseller View: GET /v1/access/reseller → children, their usage, what they owe, the margin

nodes.name: Next steps
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · the quote, the child and the margin, and what to do next: pay and sign with YOUR wallet, then claim; the keys are NOT repeated here

meta.description: The reseller path on one key: quote a Builder plan for your own key (the transfer and the message your wallet signs: nothing is paid by n8n), mint a child key for a customer of yours once you enable that node (shown once: hand it over, then delete the execution), and read what the children owe you. Needs the credential template 11 minted. Successful executions are not saved, so no key stays in execution data. Error executions are not saved either.

Start.does: you hold a Taifoon Relayer API credential (template 11); every tenant is a reseller by default

Get Access Quote.does: GET /v1/access/quote?plan=builder-99&chainId=8453 with X-API-Key: pay (the exact USDC transfer to the vault) and sign (the message naming your key); pay and sign with YOUR wallet, then Claim Plan

Mint Child Key.does: DISABLED by default (enable it to mint a real customer): POST /v1/tenant/keys { action: child, label, markup_bps }: a customer tenant with live + sandbox keys, shown ONCE; 10 a day

Get Reseller View.does: GET /v1/access/reseller: children, usage, owed (list + markup), margin; ledger rows only

Next steps.does: what to pay, sign and claim, and where the child's keys are (not here)
